svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hood: top disc 92 OD x 8, skirt 50 deep with 1.2 walls,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: printed upright; six 8 mm drain slots at the foot of the skirt.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three sockets on a 50 mm circle (90, 210 and 330 deg), 19 OD with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 15 mm bore, open at the bottom, to hold a 13 mm Palmes tube each.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two M5 heat-set inserts in the top face, 30 each side of centre: 6.8 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes, 8 deep. Three clips (18 OD, 12.8 bore, 8 high, 3 mm slit).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: tubes pushed up into the sockets, open end down; a clip on each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tube just under its socket. Two M5 x 10 screws down through the arm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tubes come from the laboratory (not in the BOM); the partner changes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: them every two to four weeks. Fitted at the anchor node and one in five.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the hood clears the pod by 22 mm and the shield cap by 14 mm.
